title: Honolulu (Oahu) real property owner roll - primary owner mailing-address geography

primary.name: City & County of Honolulu HoLIS ArcGIS - OWNINFO (combined OWNDAT + OWNMLT RPA owner tables)

tax_class.name: HoLIS CadastralTables - ASMTPITT (Real Property Assessment Tax Class (Pitt) Code Table)

situs_zip.name: HoLIS LEGDAT_ADDRESS (RPAD LEGDAT with situs address)

crosscheck.name: HoLIS CadastralTables - OWNDAT (first owner by TMK; structured tax-bill city/state/country/zip)

source.sha256_concat_pages_definition: sha256 of the page files bytes concatenated in filename order (prefix_0000.json, prefix_0001.json, ...); per-page URL, time, size and sha256 are in MANIFEST.txt
source.license: City and County of Honolulu public-records disclaimer (see item licenseInfo); data derived from RPAD records that change weekly.

notes: DATA DATE: OWNINFO layer dataLastEditDate = 2026-10-05T22:33:17Z (weekly RPAD refresh; records carry taxyr 2027). Pulled 2026-10-08 via 294 pages of 2000 rows ordered by objectid; 587,662 rows, 587,662 unique objectids (matches returnCountOnly).

PRIMARY OWNER: lowest ownseq per parid. In this layer the OWNDAT (tax-bill/first) owner has ownseq 0 (one row per parcel) and OWNMLT co-owners/lessees have ownseq >= 1, so 'lowest' = ownseq 0, not 1. 24 parids have both a Co-op Master and a Fee Owner row at ownseq 0; the Fee Owner row was used.

UNIT OF COUNT: parcels (parid = TMK + 4-digit CPR suffix), so each condo/CPR unit counts as one parcel. 4,439 condo/co-op MASTER records (common-element/land records whose mailing line is 'CONDO MASTER' or owner type Condo/Co-op Master) are excluded; analyzed universe = 322,431 parcels.

MAILING ADDRESS: the last non-empty line of address1-3 is parsed: 'CITY ST 12345[-6789]' -> US state/ZIP; else country keywords (normalized aliases, e.g. KOREA/REPUBLIC OF KOREA -> South Korea; REPUBLIC OF CHINA/TAIPEI -> Taiwan) or Canadian province+postcode -> foreign. 'Other US state' = 49 states + DC (excludes HI); US territories/freely associated USPS codes (GU, MP, AS, PR, FM, MH, PW) and military APO/FPO/DPO (AA/AE/AP) are separate buckets and count as non-Hawaii in 'non_hawaii_total'.

FALLBACK: 30,000+ ownseq-0 records have a blank mailing address. When blank (or a non-address placeholder such as 'COOP'/'>'), the lowest-ownseq OWNMLT record with an owner-type of Fee Owner/Owner/Owner-Multiclaimant/Owner-A/S and a non-blank address is used (12,486 parcels). Lessee addresses are NOT used. 'all_parcels_strict_ownseq0_only' gives the no-fallback result; headline shares move by <0.3 pt.

GAPS: 17,824 analyzed parcels (5.5%) still have no fee-owner mailing address (concentrated in industrial, preservation and commercial classes and leasehold parcels where only a lessee address exists). 'share_of_classified' excludes them; 'share_of_all_parcels_lower_bound' keeps them in the denominator. 62 addresses were unparseable and 65 were placeholders.

VALIDATION: the OWNINFO free-text parse was cross-checked against the structured taxbillstate/taxbillcountry/taxbillzip5 fields of RPAD OWNDAT (CadastralTables layer 6, same refresh). On 291,778 parcels where both have an address the hawaii / other-state / foreign / territory / military category agrees 100%; US state agrees on 288,066 and ZIP5 on 288,736. OWNDAT's blank-address set matches OWNINFO's, so the structured table cannot fill the gaps.

TMK ZONE: parid in this layer has NO county prefix (county is the separate 'jur' field, always '1'); parid = zone(1) + section(1) + plat(3) + parcel(3) + CPR(4). Zone is therefore the FIRST digit of parid (the 'second digit' rule applies only to 13-digit statewide TMKs with a county prefix). Zone place labels are approximate.

CONDO FLAGS: has_cpr is TMK-level ('Y' if the TMK has any CPR number other than 0000), so it also flags the land record of a CPR'd lot. 'by_cpr_unit_record' uses suffix != 0000 (an individual CPR unit). CPR units include high-rise condo apartments AND CPR'd house lots (common on Oahu); the data cannot separate them.

TAX CLASS (residential vs other): ASMTPITT (Real Property Assessment Tax Class 'Pitt' table, taxyr 2026, refreshed 2026-10-02) has a numeric taxratecode with NO published code-to-label lookup in the layer or item metadata. Labels are INFERRED from the data: code 1 = 91% of rows, 57% carry exemptions -> Residential (probably includes Residential A; ovrclass '11' on 30,510 code-1 rows is undocumented); code 7 = 73% in TMK 2-6 (Waikiki), 97% CPR units, ~1% exempt -> Hotel & Resort; code 3 Commercial; code 4 concentrated in zones 1/9 -> Industrial; code 5 rural, 67% no building -> Agricultural; code 6 84% no building -> Preservation; code 9 100% fully exempt -> Public Service; codes 0 and 22 unlabeled. Each parcel takes the class of its highest-value ASMTPITT row (1,549 parcels have >1 class row). Verify labels against RPAD before publishing.

OWNER-OCCUPANCY PROXY: 'residential_class1_any_exemption_by_owner_location' = share of residential (code 1) parcels with any land or building exemption > 0 in ASMTPITT. Most such exemptions are home exemptions but the field does not distinguish exemption types.

SITUS ZIP: from LEGDAT_ADDRESS (RPAD LEGDAT situs address, taxyr 2024, layer last edited 2023-10-27); matched for 310,073 of 322,431 analyzed parcels. Parcels created since 2023 are missing. Only ZIPs with >= 100 parcels are shown.

METROS: ZIP3 -> metro is a hand-built APPROXIMATE mapping of USPS 3-digit prefixes to metro/CSA-like regions (e.g. 940-951 + 954 -> 'San Francisco Bay Area'; 900-918 + 926-928 -> 'Los Angeles-Long Beach-Anaheim'). It is not an official ZIP-to-CBSA crosswalk; prefixes straddling metro lines are assigned to the dominant metro; unmapped prefixes are labeled 'Other <state> (not mapped)'.

INSTITUTIONAL OWNERS: several top out-of-state ZIPs are dominated by single mailing addresses that receive many tax bills (see parcels_at_addresses_with_10plus_parcels per ZIP and mailing_address_concentration). These are developers, timeshare/hotel operators, trusts, corporate or agent addresses rather than individual second-home owners. 'all_parcels_excluding_addresses_with_10plus_parcels' and 'residential_class1_excluding_addresses_with_10plus_parcels' remove parcels at any mailing address shared by >= 10 parcels.

INTERPRETATION: a mailing address is where the tax bill goes, not proof of residence. Out-of-state addresses can be trustees, lenders or agents for local owners; conversely, absentee owners who use a Hawaii property manager or attorney appear as Hawaii. Treat non-Hawaii shares as a floor on non-resident ownership.
NEIGHBOR ISLAND: Hawaii mailing addresses are split by ZIP: 968xx plus 96701/06/07/09/12/17/30/31/34/44/59/62/82/86/89/91/92/95/97 = Oahu; other 967xx = neighbor islands.

pctowned is 0 on every primary record, so ownership percentages are not available. No owner names or street addresses are included in this file; raw pages (which do contain address lines) are kept only in the raw folder.

crosscheck_vs_structured_OWNDAT.method: Compare category parsed from OWNINFO ownseq-0 free-text address with RPAD OWNDAT structured taxbillstate/taxbillcountry (same parid).
